view_env_state.name: view_env_state
view_env_state.description: Read one recorded EnvState step and its synchronized camera views. Step -1 selects the latest entry. Embeds up to four RGB views labeled name@step. Read-only.

geometry.name: geometry
geometry.description: Localize one visible target from the current or a recorded camera view. This host has no grounding service, so pass a [row,col] pixel measured on the selected view. Returns a world-frame center and axis-aligned extent with quality flags. Read-only; does not move the robot.

pixel.description: [row, col] chosen on the selected view; skips grounding.

view.description: Camera view; omit for the default view.

quantities.description: Requested measurements; defaults to center and extent. Use "points" for a bounded world-frame point set.

query_world_map.name: query_world_map
query_world_map.description: Read deterministic world-xyz samples from a half-open [row_start,col_start,row_end,col_end] region. The view is also the bbox coordinate space and must match the source RGB artifact; view_specs gives [height,width]. This is read-only.

view.description: Artifact view and bbox coordinate space. It must match the RGB image used to choose the bbox.

move_to.name: move_to
move_to.description: Plan and move one arm to a world-frame xyz and optional wxyz orientation. Reports pose_error and a stop_reason; completed means the waypoints ran, not that the grasp succeeded.

quat.description: Target wxyz orientation; default keeps the current orientation.

gripper.description: Optional normalized gripper command applied along the path.

substeps.description: Waypoints to execute; 0 keeps the whole planned path.

rotate_wrist.name: rotate_wrist
rotate_wrist.description: Rotate one end effector about world Z by a relative angle in degrees.

gripper.description: Optional normalized gripper command applied along the path.

substeps.description: Waypoints to execute; 0 keeps the whole planned path.

set_gripper.name: set_gripper
set_gripper.description: Move one normalized gripper to val through interpolated native actions.

release.name: release
release.description: Open one gripper, by default to 1.0, through interpolated native actions.

lingbot_act.name: lingbot_act
lingbot_act.description: Run the bound VLA policy with its native task instruction. The optional prompt is recorded but never sent to the policy.

chunks.description: Number of predictions to execute before returning feedback.

use_length.description: Native action count per prediction; fixed by the model.

prompt.description: Recorded observation about this call; not sent to the policy.

recall.name: recall
recall.description: Search published memory for prior findings. Returns matching notes with confidence and paths; inspect a match before relying on it. Every delivered match is recorded in the memory read audit.

query.description: Words to look for in titles and note bodies.

remember.name: remember
remember.description: Draft a reusable finding into the current exploration cell's inbox. Drafts are not published until the cell merges; write only what the run actually observed.

body.description: Markdown body stating the observation and when it applies.

title.description: Short global title; required for a global draft.

reason.description: Why this finding is worth keeping.

corroborate.name: corroborate
corroborate.description: Record whether this cell's run confirmed or contradicted a published memory. Merging updates its evidence and confidence.

memory_id.description: Published memory id, without the .md suffix.

outcome.description: Whether the run confirmed or contradicted the claim.

finish.name: finish
finish.description: Stop the run. A fresh native status query is authoritative; requesting success cannot override TASK_ENV.eval_success.

render.name: render
render.description: Capture a fresh synchronized RoboTwin agent observation.
